text.p: DCX Inc said on Thursday that president and chief executive Stephen Carreker has negotiated the resolution of lawsuits between DCX and Airtech International Corp.
Both parties agreed to dismiss with prejudice their claims which had been filed following the termination of merger discussions on December 9, 1996, DCX said.
Both parties have released any claims and terms of the settlement were sealed by the court, DCX said.
DCX said it had filed a claim for damages of $374,000, while Airtech International had filed a counterclaim for damages exceeding $27 million.
The suits were filed in Douglas County, Colorado district court, DCX said.
DCX designs and custom manufactures a variety of electronic systems and interconnect assemblies for use in fighter aircraft and weapons systems.
Airtech International is a Dallas-based manufacturer and distributor of air-purification systems.
